subject: Interview invitation - Software Engineering Intern
body:
Hi João,

Great work on the assessment! We'd like to invite you to a 45-minute technical interview with our engineering team for the Software Engineering Intern, Summer 2027 position.

When: Friday, October 24, 3:00-3:45 PM PT
Where: https://zoom.example/j/8812345678

You'll pair with an engineer on a practical coding problem. Let me know if this time doesn't work.

Best,
Priya Shah
University Recruiter, Northwind Robotics
